name: Stand Up India
benefit: Bank loan ₹10 lakh to ₹1 crore for SC/ST and women entrepreneurs to start businesses
benefit_hindi: SC/ST aur mahila udyamiyon ko ₹10 lakh se ₹1 crore tak ka bank loan

eligibility.description: SC/ST and women entrepreneurs for greenfield enterprises in manufacturing, services, or trading
eligibility.description_hindi: SC/ST aur mahila udyami jo naya vyavsaay shuru karna chahte hain
criteria: SC/ST entrepreneur OR woman entrepreneur (any caste)
Should not be a defaulter with any bank

steps: Visit standupmitra.in or any scheduled commercial bank
Register on Stand Up India portal
steps_hindi: standupmitra.in ya kisi bhi bank mein jaayein
Stand Up India portal par register karein
Business plan aur documents submit karein
Naye vyavsaay ke liye loan manzoor hoga

hindi_summary: Stand Up India mein SC/ST aur mahila udyamiyon ko 10 lakh se 1 crore rupaye tak ka bank loan milta hai naya vyavsaay shuru karne ke liye. standupmitra.in par apply karein ya bank jaayein.
